summary: IDACORP filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $600 million of common stock through multiple sales agents, including BofA Securities and J.P. Morgan. The filing establishes an equity distribution agreement under Rule 415, allowing periodic sales at prevailing market prices. Proceeds are expected upon physical settlement of forward sale agreements; no premium, board recommendation, or strategic catalyst is mentioned. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. No change of control, restructuring, or activist element is present. No watch items apply.
